title: Core Firmware Project Configuration
description: Defines pin assignments, clock config, and interface parameters for a Core tile firmware project.

name.description: Project name (used in build output filenames)

source.description: Clock source. hsi16=16MHz internal (available on all tiles), msi=multi-speed internal (L0/L4), hse=external crystal

sysclk_mhz.description: Target SYSCLK frequency in MHz. Without PLL, must match the source frequency.

pll.description: PLL configuration (optional — omit to run directly from source)

pins.description: Pad function assignments. Key is the pad number (as string), value is the function name from the tile JSON. Unspecified pads default to their GPIO digital function. Use 'GPIO.OUT' or 'GPIO.IN' for explicit GPIO direction. Pads not listed remain unconfigured.

gpio.description: Per-pad GPIO configuration. Keys are pad numbers (as strings) that are assigned to GPIO.OUT or GPIO.IN in the pads section. Controls pull resistors, output type, EXTI interrupts, and default output state.

direction.description: GPIO direction (informational — must match the GPIO.IN/GPIO.OUT assignment in pads)

pull.description: Internal pull resistor: none, up (pull-up), or down (pull-down)

output_type.description: Output driver type (only for GPIO.OUT pads)

exti.description: Enable edge-triggered EXTI interrupt (only for GPIO.IN pads). Callback is NULL — set at runtime via hal_exti_enable().

default.description: Default output state set during init (only for GPIO.OUT pads)

interfaces.description: Configuration parameters for each interface used. Keys are interface names from the tile JSON (e.g., 'I2C1', 'USART2').

speed.description: Clock speed in Hz (for I2C, SPI)

bootloader.description: DFU bootloader mode. 'custom' = 8KB DFU 1.1 bootloader (1209:0002), app at 0x08002000. 'rom' = ST ROM DfuSe bootloader (0483:DF11), app at 0x08000000. 'none' = no DFU, flash via SWD or BOOT0. The Makefile reads this and sets BOOTLOADER/ROM_DFU flags automatically.
